messages:
jess_fin: FYI Silverpine Consulting sent INV-52210 for $23,600. AP auto-flagged MISSING_PO + TAX_WITHHOLDING. Invoice aggregates two projects; vendor referenced contract C-2025-Silverpine, no PO. Need routing.

mia_proc: Can you drop the invoice PDF and the remittance? If two projects, vendor should have used two POs or line-level PO refs.

jess_fin: attached invoice and vendor email. They show lines for Project Alpha (requested PO-901) and Project Beta (no PO). Also a 5% foreign withholding labeled "tax withheld" reducing net due.

ap-system: MATCH_FAIL: candidates=[PO-901]; missing_candidate=PO-?; reason=ambiguous_line_allocation; tax_withholding_detected=5%.

leo_fpna: Withholding complicates accounting. We need vendor's tax certificate (W-8 or local equivalent) to substantiate withholding for reclaim. Also clarify whether we should pay net or gross. If no certificate, pay gross and seek credit later.

mike_proc: Procurement confirms PO-901 exists for Project Alpha only. We never issued PO for Project Beta because scope change was handled via change-order but procurement backlog prevented a new PO. Vendor should have called out two PO refs.

procure-bot: Ticket PR-4780 created: "Silverpine INV-52210 - missing PO for Project Beta; tax withheld on invoice" assigned to procurement-queue.

jess_fin: Vendor emailed back: account manager says withholding is per local rules and they expect net pay; they can provide local tax receipt but not a US W-8. They also offered to reissue invoice with PO-901 and "No-PO" line split for Beta.

leo_fpna: Acceptable path: request reissued invoice that shows gross amounts per line, the withholding line as a separate credit, and explicit PO references. Also request tax receipt for the withholding. If vendor can't provide tax receipt by payrun cutoff, finance will pay gross and seek reclaim. Approver for variance: leo_fpna.

amanda_ops: Payrun is Tuesday. Set hold and deadline: vendor must provide reissued invoice + tax doc by EOD Monday to be considered for net payment. Otherwise process gross payment for both lines and create GL reclaim entry.

mike_proc: I'll expedite procurement to issue a retro PO for Project Beta (PO-904 draft) and attach to PR-4780. If procurement can't issue before cutoff, we proceed with gross payment per Amanda.

jess_fin: Noted. I've asked vendor to reissue and upload tax receipt to PR-4780. Tagging @mia_proc for follow-up.

amanda_ops: AP Queue: Invoice INV-52210 moved to "Pending Vendor Action" with hold timer 48h. Add note to PR-4780 if we pay gross so tax reclaim work can start.

jess_fin: Will close loop once PR-4780 has either reissued invoice + tax doc or payment record. Thanks.
